title: Togglebeam
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small stereo master; first 64 seconds form the game mix, full single-pass 128-second master forms the station mix; -3.5 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Produce one ORIGINAL 128-second stereo SYNTHWAVE GROOVE for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT 125 BPM in 4/4. AT TIME ZERO the complete groove is already playing loudly: dry kick every quarter note, snare on beats two and four, crisp eighth-note hi-hats, and a short bright midrange woodblock or bell on every beat. Keep these four layers at the SAME full audible level during EVERY SECOND of the entire 128 seconds, including 0-16, 48-96 and 112-128 seconds. Absolutely no intro, fade, ramp, quiet passage, breakdown, pad-only section, half-time, silent gap, tempo drift or reverb masking the beat. Above the continuous drum loop, alternate two clipped analog-synth stabs left and right, then answer with three higher glass-key notes rising in pitch. Use a round pulsing bass and restrained warm minor-to-major chords below the short attacks. Change the melody register, bass roots and chord sequence halfway through while the same drums and short key attacks never stop; end on a new cadence with drums still audible until the end. Bright, clean, playful and controlled highs. No vocals, speech, sampled recordings, known melody or imitation of any existing song.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Create a brand-new SQUARE 1:1 original duohertz album cover for Togglebeam, an all-ages synthwave rhythm-game track. High-contrast original editorial comic-print collage on near-black ink, warm-ivory cut paper, coral red and electric cyan. Main motif: ONE giant unbranded warm-ivory TOGGLE LEVER with a broad angular handle pointing diagonally between two separate flat paper color fields, coral on the left and electric cyan on the right; a single straight cyan beam extends from the lever tip to the upper right. The lever should be a bold simple abstract shape, not a keycap, control dial, record player or real device. Crisp tactile edges, sparse halftone, strong readable silhouette at 100px and quiet dark lower fifth for a local title overlay. No numbers, ticks, screen, cassette, car, city, person, text, letters, logos, watermark or copied game art.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Togglebeam square cover into a HORIZONTAL 1.9:1 duohertz social-sharing card. Preserve ONE oversized blank warm-ivory angular toggle lever pointing diagonally between separate coral-left and electric-cyan-right paper fields, with one straight cyan beam extending from its tip; near-black comic-print ink and sparse halftone. Recompose the lever and beam on the RIGHT two-thirds; leave calm dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp fully legible English lines there: 'duohertz' in lowercase electric cyan and 'Togglebeam' in larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly. Purpose-build the wide layout, do not stretch the square. No other text, letters, numbers, keycaps, dials, record players, cars, people, logos, watermark or copied game art.
